steps.title: Assuming Ihram for Hajj Ifrad
steps.instructions: Prepare yourself by trimming nails, combing hair, and taking a bath (ghusl) if possible. Wear the white unstitched garments for men, while women wear modest regular clothing covering everything except the face and hands. Make the intention (niyyah) specifically for Hajj Ifrad at the designated Miqat, and recite the Talbiyah.
steps.location_context: At the Miqat boundary corresponding to your route of arrival (e.g., Dul Hulaifah for those coming from Madinah).
steps.adab: Keep your heart focused on humility, maintain a tranquil demeanor, and frequently recite the Talbiyah.
steps.dua: Labbaik Allahumma labbaik, labbaik la sharika laka labbaik...
steps.safety_notes: Stay hydrated and avoid overexertion during travel preparations.
steps.image_prompt: An educational diagram showing the Miqat boundaries surrounding Makkah.
steps.image_caption: Map of Miqat stations for pilgrims arriving in Makkah.
steps.image_alt_text: Map showing Miqat locations around Makkah.

steps.title: Arrival and Tawaf al-Qudum
steps.instructions: Upon arriving in Makkah, proceed to the Grand Mosque (Masjid al-Haram) for Tawaf al-Qudum (Arrival Tawaf). Perform seven circuits around the Kaaba in an anti-clockwise direction, starting and ending at the Black Stone corner.
steps.adab: Walk with dignity and lower your gaze. Avoid pushing or harming fellow pilgrims.
steps.safety_notes: Crowds can be dense. Elderly users should use designated accessible paths and avoid peak hours.
steps.image_prompt: A respectful overhead illustration of pilgrims performing Tawaf around the Kaaba.
steps.image_caption: Pilgrims performing Tawaf around the Kaaba.
steps.image_alt_text: Overhead view of pilgrims performing Tawaf.

steps.title: Sa'i between Safa and Marwah
steps.instructions: After completing Tawaf, perform Sa'i by walking seven times between the hills of Safa and Marwah, beginning at Safa and ending at Marwah.
steps.location_context: The enclosed multi-level Sa'i corridor connecting Safa and Marwah.
steps.adab: Remember Allah, supplicate, and walk calmly in the designated pedestrian lanes.
steps.safety_notes: Take breaks on the upper levels if you feel fatigued. Keep elderly family members close.
steps.image_prompt: An illustration showing the walking path between Safa and Marwah.
steps.image_caption: The path of Sa'i between Safa and Marwah.

steps.title: Remaining in Ihram until Eid al-Adha
steps.instructions: Unlike Tamattu, a pilgrim performing Hajj Ifrad remains in the state of Ihram continuously after arriving in Makkah, waiting until the 10th of Dhu al-Hijjah before exiting Ihram.
steps.adab: Abstain from all prohibitions of Ihram, such as trimming hair, cutting nails, and hunting.
steps.safety_notes: Maintain health and rest adequately during the waiting days before Mina.
steps.image_prompt: A calm scene depicting a pilgrim resting and reading in Makkah.
steps.image_caption: Pilgrim resting in Makkah during the waiting period.

steps.title: Departure to Mina for Tarwiyah
steps.instructions: On the 8th of Dhu al-Hijjah (Day of Tarwiyah), travel to Mina and spend the day and night there, performing the five daily prayers at their proper times.
steps.adab: Engage in remembrance of Allah, maintain patience, and assist neighbors in your tent.
steps.safety_notes: Follow designated transport schedules and hydration guidelines in the heat.
steps.image_prompt: A wide-angle view of the white tent city in Mina.
steps.image_alt_text: Overview of the white tents in Mina.

steps.title: Standing at Arafat
steps.instructions: On the 9th of Dhu al-Hijjah, move from Mina to Arafat after sunrise. Remain within the boundaries of Arafat, engaging in sincere supplication, prayers, and remembrance until sunset.
steps.location_context: Plain of Arafat and Jabal al-Rahmah.
steps.adab: Face the Qiblah while supplicating and spend the day in deep introspection and repentance.
steps.safety_notes: Arafat can be extremely hot. Use umbrellas, drink plenty of fluids, and stay shaded.
steps.image_prompt: An educational view of the Plain of Arafat with pilgrims gathered.
steps.image_caption: Pilgrims gathered on the Plain of Arafat.

steps.title: Muzdalifah Night Stay
steps.instructions: After sunset on the 9th of Dhu al-Hijjah, proceed to Muzdalifah. Combine Maghrib and Isha prayers upon arrival, spend the night under the open sky, and gather pebbles for the stoning ritual.
steps.adab: Rest peacefully and avoid disturbing others during the night.
steps.safety_notes: Keep track of your group as Muzdalifah is dark and crowded at night.
steps.image_prompt: An illustration of pilgrims resting under the night sky in Muzdalifah.

steps.title: Stoning Jamrat al-Aqabah and Exiting Ihram
steps.instructions: Return to Mina on the morning of the 10th of Dhu al-Hijjah (Eid al-Adha). Throw seven pebbles at Jamrat al-Aqabah. Afterward, shave or trim your hair to exit the state of Ihram (note: animal sacrifice is not mandatory for Ifrad).
steps.adab: Remain calm and avoid aggressive throwing or pushing near the pillars.
steps.safety_notes: Use pedestrian bridges and follow crowd management advisories strictly.
steps.image_prompt: A diagram of the Jamarat pillars indicating the stoning area.

steps.title: Tawaf al-Ifadah and Sa'i
steps.instructions: Travel to Makkah to perform Tawaf al-Ifadah around the Kaaba and Sa'i between Safa and Marwah. (Note: Since Ifrad pilgrims already performed Sa'i upon arrival, scholarly opinions differ on whether it must be repeated; consult your guide if needed).
steps.adab: Maintain humility and gratitude while completing the core pillars of Hajj.
steps.safety_notes: Pace yourself and use wheelchairs if mobility is limited.
steps.image_prompt: An illustration of pilgrims performing Tawaf and Sa'i.

steps.title: Days of Tashreeq and Tawaf al-Wada
steps.instructions: Return to Mina to spend the nights of the 11th, 12th (and optionally 13th) of Dhu al-Hijjah, throwing seven pebbles at each of the three Jamarat daily after midday. Conclude your pilgrimage before departure by performing Tawaf al-Wada (Farewell Tawaf).
steps.adab: Express gratitude to Allah, maintain peace in the camps, and bid farewell to the Holy Mosque with reverence.
steps.safety_notes: Watch out for heat exhaustion during daytime stoning sessions.
steps.image_prompt: A peaceful depiction of the Farewell Tawaf around the illuminated Kaaba.
steps.image_caption: Performing Tawaf al-Wada before leaving Makkah.
